purpose: Shared rendering and measurement atlas. Never a native input region or mask.
units: CSS pixels / WPF device-independent pixels before DPI conversion

points.expectation: Underlying app: empty area inside single window, outside both split windows
Underlying app: decorative shadow outside silhouette, even if alpha is nonzero
Underlying app: vertical gap between bar and popup
Underlying app: outside every spike window; retain same screen coordinate in split mode
Toolbar counter increments once; no event in underlying app
Menu action counter increments once; no event in underlying app

edgeSamples.method: Sample 1, 2 and 4 physical pixels on each side of an observed silhouette edge after DPI conversion. Record antialiasing separately.
edgeSamples.warning: Pixel alpha zero and decorative nonzero-alpha shadow are different cases. CSS pointer-events does not guarantee native click-through.
